sequenceDiagram

  actor B as Bob
  A->>B: Hello

  A-xB: lost
  Note right of B: a note
  Note over A,B: over both

name: seq-blocks
mmd:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  A->>B: start
  loop Every minute
    B->>A: ping
  end
  alt ok
    A->>B: yes
  else no
    A->>B: no
  end
  opt maybe
    A->>B: opt
  end
  par p1
    A->>B: one
  and p2
    A->>C: two
  end
  critical c
    A->>B: crit
  option o
    A->>B: opt
  end
  break stop
    A->>B: break
  end
  rect rgb(200,220,255)
    A->>B: in rect
  end
  activate B
  B->>A: act
  deactivate B
